_comment: THE STORES THE FACTORY IS HELD AGAINST, and every one of them is a real
request from the Issues tab rather than a site chosen because it works.
That is the whole point: a suite built from stores that already pass
proves nothing, and until 22 September 2026 every fault in this factory
was found by a colleague pasting a URL rather than by anything here.
factory/soak.mjs reads this list, runs the READ HALF against each one and
reports what a demo built from it would contain. It makes no demo and
expect is what a good build looks like for that store, recorded the first
time it was seen. A store that drops below it has regressed, and the
report says so rather than leaving somebody to compare by eye. A store
with no expect block is being watched rather than judged.
A STORE THAT CANNOT BE READ STAYS ON THIS LIST. vperfumes and
mercadolivre are here because they are hard, not despite it: the answer
for a store behind a bot wall is a clean refusal and a request for a CSV,
and that path deserves testing as much as the happy one.

EXPECT IS TODAY, NOT THE TARGET. Each block is what that store actually gave on 22 September 2026, so a drop is a regression in this repository. Two stores have no expect block because they currently produce a demo with no navigable shelves at all, and recording that as acceptable would be writing a fault down as a standard. Their notes say so instead.
